observations: /library loaded on http://localhost:5174 with Enterprise Policy Library visible.

Fresh/direct /library/GV-GB-001, /library/CL-CA-001, and /library/CO-HP-101 screenshots show Policy not found, so policy references are not reload-safe.
ACHC Survey View is present and shows survey filters/mapping cards; no ACHC defect retained after visual check.

Print routes for GV-GB-001, CL-CA-001, CO-HP-101, gv-gb-001, and cl-ca-001 rendered content; no print-not-found or placeholder-content defect retained.

defects.professional_identity: Compliance Officer; Administrator; Director of Nursing; Surveyor
defects.steps_to_reproduce: Open /library/GV-GB-001, /library/CL-CA-001, or /library/CO-HP-101 directly in a fresh tab or after hard refresh.
defects.expected_result: Direct policy detail routes render the selected policy with content, metadata, references, and print/download actions.
defects.actual_result: Direct policy detail routes render a
state. The same GV-GB-001 policy can render after clicking from the library SPA list, so route/reload behavior is inconsistent and not survey-defensible.
defects.recommended_fix: Normalize and initialize policy detail routing from the canonical corpus/store on direct load; add reload tests for /library/:policyId before relying on survey or printed references.
defects.blocking_status: Demo blocker and survey traceability blocker

defects.steps_to_reproduce: Open lowercase policy links such as /library/gv-gb-001, /library/cl-ca-001, or /library/co-hp-101.
defects.expected_result: Policy route params are canonicalized so external links, copied URLs, and references recover to the correct policy.
defects.actual_result: Lowercase direct routes render missing policy/corpus state.
defects.recommended_fix: Canonicalize policy route params before store and corpus lookup; redirect to canonical uppercase route when needed.

defects.steps_to_reproduce: Open /surveyor/policy/gv-gb-001 from a copied/lowercase survey reference.
defects.expected_result: Surveyor viewer opens the selected policy and ACHC/survey context regardless of route casing.
defects.actual_result: Surveyor route displays a missing corpus/not-found state for lowercase GV-GB-001, while uppercase surveyor routes work.
defects.recommended_fix: Use one canonical policy ID lookup for surveyor routes and normalize incoming route params.

defects.steps_to_reproduce: Open /library, click GV-GB-001, and inspect the action bar.
defects.expected_result: Policy detail exposes both print and download/save-PDF actions consistently across policies.
defects.actual_result: GV-GB-001 detail shows Print but no visible Download action, unlike other tested policy detail routes.
defects.recommended_fix: Align GV-GB-001 special detail renderer with the shared policy detail actions or route it through the shared renderer.

defects.steps_to_reproduce: Open Policy Library or a policy detail route during UAT and observe the lower-right overlay.
defects.expected_result: Policy and surveyor users can read cards/content without unrelated overlay panels obstructing references or actions.
defects.actual_result: checklist panel overlays policy cards and policy content, including the ACHC survey view and GV-GB-001 detail screenshots.
defects.recommended_fix: Hide or minimize the guided UAT overlay for production/demo/surveyor policy routes, or persist dismissal before evidence screenshots/exports.
